title: fx: a Zig coding agent shaped like a Unix command, interactive, one-shot, or WebAssembly

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: FX is a compact coding agent written in Zigg, shaped more like a Unix command than a terminal IDE. It can run interactively, answer oneshot requests, resume saved sessions, or embed inside another application as a native binary or web assembly module. Skills, MCP tools, sub aents, and scope permission rules extend the core without changing its shell-like interface.
